cues: Impersonal passives, the language of news and reports, have two routes.
People believe that she is innocent: it is believed that she is innocent, or, she is believed to be innocent.
They report that the bridge collapsed: it is reported that the bridge collapsed, or the bridge is reported to have collapsed.
When the event is earlier, use to have plus the past participle.
